> I have an 480x480 tft lcd touch screen that is wired to an esp32 S3 with 16MB flash and 8MB PSRAM. The boards also has an micro sd card slot and a audio chip. The whole thing can be powered by an onboard lipo battery charging unit. Im planning on making a case but i don't have any sort of 3 d printer so maybe I can order online or ask friend. This Tetris will have a upgrades menu and you get coins from every row to delete and combos multiply the coin reward. In the shop menu you can get boosts that can temporarily effect gameplay and permanent upgrades like moving around faster .
